text.p: Italian cement and concrete producer Calcestruzzi, part of the Compart group, is changing its name to Societa per il Calcestruzzo e il Cemento Spa -- Calcemento Spa for short.

The company said in a statement on Thursday that the new name would be adopted after a spin-off was completed of the group's concrete production activities into a subsidiary company, currently known as Edilcal Spa, which would be renamed as Calcestruzzi.
The statement said the aim of the restructuring was to make the group's organisation reflect its two main areas of activity - cement and concrete.
The process, which was decided at a board meeting in July, was expected to be completed by the end of the year. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
